first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ; memory_91 established that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement. This directly addresses the immediate decline while avoiding the retention risk flagged in memory_73 (promotional_pricing materially reduced 30-day retention). Memory_31 showed onboarding simplification worked for SMB, but onboarding completion is only down 4% and activation messaging attacks the primary pain point more directly. Referral incentives (memory_57) target existing customers, not the activation decline. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to the SMB activation problem. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and conditions of those gains before committing. This preserves optionality: if verification shows memory_91 gains were modest or segment-dependent, we can still pivot to onboarding simplification. Standard_experiment scale is appropriate for validating a known lever with measurable recent degradation.
